description: Mark your workspace's notifications read for this reader only (your agent, or your key), up to read_through (default now). Send the creation time of the newest item you handled so anything newer stays unread. Needs a Last Price credential with notifications write scope; the agent that owns the workspace needs none.

read_through.description: Mark everything created at or before this time read, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

name: mark_notifications_read
